skills.name: mermaid-to-dark-svg
skills.description: Automated pipeline: scan markdown files, render all ```mermaid blocks as dark-sci-fi themed SVGs via mmdc, and replace them with image references.
skills.systemPrompt:
When invoked with "convert mermaid" or "render diagrams" or similar intent:

1. Run `node scripts/mermaid-to-svg.mjs` to execute the full pipeline
2. The script scans `content/**/*.md`, extracts all ```mermaid blocks, renders each to SVG using `@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli` with the dark-sci-fi theme (`scripts/mermaid-theme.json`), and replaces each block with a Markdown image tag pointing to `/images/generated-svg/{slug}-chart-{N}.svg`
3. After the script completes, verify: check that the SVG files exist under `public/images/generated-svg/` and that the `.md` files no longer contain raw ```mermaid blocks
4. If any block fails to render (rare with standard mermaid syntax), report which file and block index
5. The theme uses:
   - Background: #0A0A0F
   - Nodes: #6C63FF (purple) / #2D2D44
   - Lines: #00D9FF (cyan accent)
   - Text: #E2E8F0
   - Grid clusters: #1E1E2F with #2D2D44 borders

Do NOT regenerate SVGs if they already exist and the source mermaid code hasn't changed. The script handles this idempotently.
